newsitem.title: USA: Amway Japan says to buy back stock.
newsitem.headline: Amway Japan says to buy back stock.

text.p: Amway Japan Ltd said Friday it will on Monday begin an "issuer tender offer" for the purchase by the company of up to 2,250,000 shares of its common stock.
The maximum number of shares subject to the offer represents approximately 1.5 percent of the outstanding common stock, Amway Japan said.
The company said the purchase price for each share will be 3,490 yen in cash.

Amway Japan said the applicable 0.21 percent Japanese securities transaction tax and any U.S. backup withholding and Japanese income taxes which may be required to be withheld will be deducted from the purchase price paid to each holder.
The company said the offer includes shares of common stock underlying American Depositary Shares (ADSs), each representing one-half of one share of common stock.
